remarks: Welcome to the Hazel, a stylish double attached garage duplex in The Orchards, just steps from a pond and K-9 public school. The open-concept main floor features LARGE WINDOWS, a bright great room, spacious dining area with a sliding patio door, and a kitchen with full-height cabinetry, 3 CM quartz countertops, Silgranit sink, premium appliances, and gas line to the range rough-in. A enclosed SIDE ENTRANCE and 150 AMP panel offer excellent future basement development. Upstairs you'll find 3 spacious bedrooms, a versatile bonus room, convenient upper laundry, and a well-designed family-friendly layout. Built with the Healthier Homes Initiative, this home includes reverse osmosis water filtration, radon mitigation, and a furnace equipped with UV light and carbon filtration. The Orchards is a vibrant, family-friendly community in southeast Edmonton, this home provides access to an abundance of parks, ponds. (Photos are of showhome) $15,000 builder promotion has been applied to listing price. (id:67522)
